headline: Iran shadow-tanker floating storage fully depleted after US blockade
dek: Iran's floating crude storage in Asian waters was fully depleted by mid-October after the US naval blockade prevented replenishment; CENTCOM says the blockade denied Tehran at least $25B in oil revenue.
fault_line: Is Iran really out of oil money, or is crude still flowing through Oman/Iraq channels the blockade can't see?
